title: Scottsdale Travel Guide

hero.headline: Scottsdale Travel Guide
hero.subheadline: Combine Old Town, Sonoran Desert trails, architecture, art, golf, dining, and resort time without confusing Scottsdale with neighboring Phoenix.

overview: Scottsdale is a separate city within the Phoenix metropolitan area, stretching from a walkable Old Town core north into extensive Sonoran Desert foothills.
The city's outdoor identity centers on the McDowell Sonoran Preserve and Pinnacle Peak, while Old Town, museums, galleries, architecture, and dining supply the urban half of the trip.

highlights.title: Old Town Scottsdale
highlights.description: Walkable districts combine galleries, restaurants, museums, shops, and nightlife.

highlights.title: McDowell Sonoran Preserve
highlights.description: The city preserve protects a large block of Sonoran Desert and an extensive non-motorized trail network.

highlights.title: Architecture and design
highlights.description: Taliesin West links Scottsdale directly to Frank Lloyd Wright's desert architecture.

highlights.title: Resort and golf culture
highlights.description: Spas, resorts, golf, and outdoor dining are a major part of the visitor economy.

thingsToDo.title: Explore Old Town Scottsdale
thingsToDo.description: Walk the Arts, Historic, and entertainment districts rather than treating Old Town as a single attraction.

thingsToDo.title: Hike the McDowell Sonoran Preserve
thingsToDo.description: Choose a route that matches your fitness and the weather. Start early, carry water, and respect preserve rules.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Taliesin West
thingsToDo.description: Tour Frank Lloyd Wright's desert laboratory and home; advance reservations are strongly recommended.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Scottsdale Museum of Contemporary Art
thingsToDo.description: Pair SMoCA with Old Town galleries and public art for a concentrated arts half-day.

thingsToDo.title: Hike Pinnacle Peak
thingsToDo.description: This maintained desert trail is popular for views and fitness; go early during warm weather.

thingsToDo.title: Use the Scottsdale Waterfront and Arizona Canal paths
thingsToDo.description: These walkable corridors connect shopping, dining, public art, and canal-side paths near Old Town.

bestTimeToVisit.title: Late fall through spring is best for outdoor-heavy trips
bullets: Winter and spring are peak seasons for hiking, golf, events, and patios.
Summer is extremely hot; shift outdoor activity to dawn and use pools, spas, museums, and dining midday.
Spring events can raise hotel rates and crowd levels.

travelTips: Scottsdale is not Phoenix; keep city names accurate when describing attractions.
Book Taliesin West, popular tours, golf, and high-demand restaurants ahead in peak season.
Desert heat changes trail safety rapidly; do not rely on generic seasonal advice.

faq.q: How many days are ideal for Scottsdale?
faq.a: Three days gives time for Old Town, desert hiking, architecture, and resort or dining experiences.
Camelback sits on the Phoenix/Paradise Valley side of the metro; it is a nearby regional hike, not a Scottsdale city attraction.

faq.q: What is Scottsdale's best outdoor area?
faq.a: The McDowell Sonoran Preserve is the city's defining protected desert landscape.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Scottsdale is an incorporated Sonoran Desert city in the Phoenix metropolitan area with a distinctive mix of Old Town culture, desert preserves, resorts, and design.

sections.heading: Geography & setting
paragraphs: The city extends north from the Salt River valley into foothills adjoining the McDowell Mountains.

sections.heading: History & culture
paragraphs: Old Town preserves early town character while galleries, museums, public art, and Taliesin West give Scottsdale a strong arts-and-design identity.

sections.heading: Outdoor highlights
paragraphs: The McDowell Sonoran Preserve, Pinnacle Peak, cycling routes, golf, and desert tours dominate outdoor planning.

sections.heading: Getting around
paragraphs: Old Town is walkable; northern trailheads and resort districts are easier by car or rideshare.
